output.body: Take countdown(n): if n is 0 it returns without calling itself, otherwise it prints n and calls countdown(n-1). Tracing countdown(2) gives calls with n = 2, then n = 1, then n = 0, and at n = 0 the if-branch returns, so no new call starts.
